description: A WinUI 3 developer needs the UI DispatcherQueue from a view model after coming from WPF Dispatcher, based on https://stackoverflow.com/questions/69885338/how-to-get-dispatcherqueue-in-winui-3-desktop-using-windows-app-sdk.
prompt: In WPF I could get Dispatcher from almost any control. In this WinUI 3 app my view model starts background work and then DispatcherQueue.GetForCurrentThread() is null, so the status text update never runs. What's the right pattern?
